questions: My best friend just told me they've been struggling with depression for months but never said anything. I don't know what to say to them.
I've been working really hard on a project for six months and my manager just assigned it to someone else without any explanation. How should I handle this?
My elderly neighbor seems lonely and knocks on my door almost every day to chat, but I'm really busy with work. What should I do?
I just found out I got the promotion I've been working toward for two years, but my colleague who also applied seems really devastated. How do I act around them now?
My teenage son barely talks to me anymore and spends all his time in his room. I'm worried but don't want to push him away further.
A coworker keeps making mistakes on shared projects and when I try to bring it up, they get defensive and upset. How do I address this?
I recently lost my job and I'm trying to explain my situation to family members who keep offering unsolicited advice. It's exhausting.
Someone on my team disclosed that they're going through a difficult divorce and their performance has been slipping. I'm their supervisor. What should I do?
My close friend is in a relationship I think is unhealthy for them, but every time I try to bring it up, they shut down the conversation.
I witnessed a stranger crying alone on a park bench today and wasn't sure whether to approach them or give them privacy. What would you have done?
